chapters.text: Every rupee in one list. Expense = spent, Money in = received, Transfer = moved between two people (not spending).
Click Expense, Money in or Transfer.
Enter date, amount, who paid, category and paid to.
Take a photo of the bill or choose the file.
Save. The entry shows No proof until a bill is attached.
To repeat last month's bill, click the copy icon on that row and change date, amount and bill.
